name: Image-space Volume Ray Marching
definition: Rendering 3D volumes by creating a full-screen quad and running a fragment shader for every pixel, rather than using an in-scene model (like a box) to encapsulate the volume.
summary: Image-space Volume Ray Marching renders volumetric data as a post-processing effect by executing a fragment shader per pixel, bypassing explicit geometry occlusion to rely on screen-space depth testing.
